from pathlib import Path
import json, re
roots=[Path('store/jobs'),Path('store/imports')]
needle=b'userkey'
out=[]
for root in roots:
 if not root.exists(): continue
 for p in root.rglob('*'):
  if not p.is_file(): continue
  try: b=p.read_bytes()
  except Exception: continue
  matches=[]
  for enc,n in [('ascii',needle),('utf16le',b''.join(bytes([c,0]) for c in needle))]:
   lo=b.lower(); q=n.lower(); pos=0
   while (i:=lo.find(q,pos))>=0:
    matches.append({'encoding':enc,'offset':i})
    pos=i+len(q)
  if matches: out.append({'path':str(p),'size':len(b),'matches':matches})
print(json.dumps({'needle':'userkey','files_with_hits':len(out),'occurrences':sum(len(x['matches']) for x in out),'hits':out},indent=2))
